content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. 💪 Research shows that sets taken close to failure (about 0-3 reps left) build similar muscle across a wide range, roughly 5-30 reps. Lighter loads work as long as the effort is high. Heavier loads of about 6-12 reps are still the most time-efficient, and they carry over best to your 100 kg bench goal.

For you, I'd mostly train in the 5-10 rep range on the bench and add some 10-20 rep accessory work. Want me to check how your bench is trending?
